capabilities: Run text processing patterns on the active note, clipboard, or Tavily search results
Chain multiple patterns sequentially or stitch their outputs together
Fetch YouTube transcripts as input for pattern processing
Create workflows and add them as command palette items
Download patterns from the Fabric repository or manage a custom pattern folder
extras: Installation via BRAT is documented, suggesting the plugin may not be in the official community plugin store. Only Grocq, OpenAI, and Ollama are confirmed working; other providers are still under development.
intentEvidence: This plugin is a sibling project to the Unofficial Fabric Plugin.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to apply reusable AI prompts to note content or connect to AI providers from within the vault.

relations.evidence: The Mesh AI plugin emulates the functionality provided by the Fabric tool within your Obsidian vault.

summary: AI plugin that stores prompts as patterns and runs them on notes, clipboard, or Tavily search results using multiple AI providers.
